response.justification: The candidate is a talented full-stack and DevOps engineer with strong communication abilities, but lacks the critical mandatory technical requirements for this mid-senior capital markets C++ role. With only 6 months of professional C++ experience versus the required 5-10 years, no demonstrated capital markets or fixed income domain knowledge, and insufficient specialization in SQL Server/Oracle, the candidate faces substantial barriers to success. This role requires either significant financial domain expertise paired with C++ fundamentals, or 5-10 years of robust C++ development experience—neither of which the candidate demonstrates.
strengths: Excellent communication and mentoring skills demonstrated through workshops, public speaking, and open-source community leadership
Strong CI/CD pipeline and infrastructure expertise with hands-on experience building and maintaining deployment systems
Proven ability to quickly master multiple programming languages and successfully adapt to diverse technical domains
concerns: Only 6 months of professional C++ experience versus the mandatory 5-10 years requirement
No demonstrated background in capital markets, fixed income, financial services, or investment banking domain
Career focused on web and Linux systems with no evidence of Windows platform development or SQL Server/Oracle specialization
